nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text:
#HMPvirus is considered ubiquitous. 
As per reports 
1. By age 24 months, 52% of children had detected hMPV antibodies. In children 2 - 5 yrs seropositivity reaching 80%
By age > 10 years 100% of patients were seropositive 
Reinfection is common throughout life with equal rates https://t.co/tATfua8hQp

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text:
is detected throughout the year, with a peak incidence from late winter to early spring, later than the seasonal peak of RSV & influenza 
Northern hemisphere, the hMPV peak tends to be from January - March; in the southern hemisphere, the peak is from June to July.

nodes.author: SunilRaina15
nodes.text:
#HMPV
prospective, population-based surveillance studies in children < 5 years of age demonstrated that hMPV was detected in 6% of hospitalized children, 7% of children seen in ED & 1% of asymptomatic controls.
